context: A police officer briefs about a case
purpose: Teach: 王者/焦り/断る/発散/流用/取り残さ/風情/跡地

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 業界の王者と呼ばれる企業、関与、調査中です。
lines.en: We're currently investigating a firm known as an industry leader — their involvement in this case.
lines.style: Professional, measured cadence. Matter-of-fact opening. Even tone, neither rushed nor dragging. The voice of someone laying out facts without editorializing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、焦りで、ミス、犯したようですね。
lines.en: The suspect seems to have made a panicked mistake — something that gave them away.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly forward-leaning. Not questioning, but genuinely working through the logic. Quiet underlying sharpness. Ends with a note of intellectual satisfaction.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。協力依頼、断る人もいます。
lines.en: Yes. We've asked for cooperation, but some people refuse to talk.
lines.style: Steady, acknowledging the friction without dwelling on it. Slightly heavier weight on the acknowledgment. Clinical acceptance of human reluctance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者の怒り、発散する場、必要ですね。
lines.en: The victim needs a space where their anger can actually be heard — that matters.
lines.style: Gentle but deliberate. Not probing for a reaction, but naming something real. Slight pause before the last phrase, like he's checking if he's being too honest.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。公費流用の疑い、別件で調査中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're also investigating separately for signs of public funds being diverted.
lines.style: Continues the steady procedural tone. Matter-of-fact shift to the next layer of the case. No emotion, but attention is complete.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者、取り残されない対応、警察、頑張ってますね。
lines.en: The police are trying to make sure the victim isn't abandoned in all of this — that's the work being done.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation underlying the observation. Soft but not soft-handed. A quiet acknowledgment of effort that often goes unseen.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。事件現場、風情の残る地域です。
lines.en: Yes. The crime scene is in an older neighborhood — one with a lot of history.
lines.style: Slight shift inward, more reflective. Eyes moving to somewhere beyond the conversation. Noticing the place itself, not just the facts. Quieter pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 空き家の跡地、犯罪リスク、上がりますね。
lines.en: Abandoned buildings like that — they create real openings for crime. The risk goes up.
lines.style: Connecting the details with quiet certainty. Not alarmed, but clear-eyed about cause and effect. The tone of someone who has thought this through before.
